c-01031500-signatures-20261020.claim: The Piscataquis River basin at Dover-Foxcroft, Maine (USGS 01031500) has an NLDI-delineated watershed area of 774 km2 and, over 1989-10-01 to 2009-09-30, exhibits a runoff ratio of 0.61, a baseflow index of 0.45, and a streamflow elasticity of 1.76 using a Lyne-Hollick digital filter.
c-01031500-signatures-20261020.confidence_rationale: Signatures were computed from 7,305 observed daily streamflow values (USGS NWIS) and basin-averaged GridMET precipitation, with bootstrap 90% confidence intervals reported for each statistic; water-balance consistency passed.
limitations: Baseflow separation assumes the Lyne-Hollick one-parameter filter with alpha=0.925 and three passes
Runoff ratio and elasticity depend on the GridMET precipitation product interpolated over the basin
Stationarity was not checked because full streamflow arrays were not retained in the session streamflow slot
